name: Inaho Shin
source:
Memories Off ~Sorekara~:
A frequenter of the café Narazu-ya and a freeter. He lives on the first floor of the apartment "Higurashi-sou"; the same apartment as [url=/c11657]Isshu[/url]. He works part-time at the chain restaurant "Ressac" where he continually gets accolades; It's rumored he's due for a big promotion. He's saving up money for his next journey abroad.

Memories Off #5 Togireta Film; Memories Off #5 encore:
[url=/c11811]Haruto[/url]'s neighbor at the apartment "Higurashi-sou." After returning from Nepal, Shin returned to working part-time at the chain restaurant "Ressac" where he becomes co-workers with [url=/c10459]Mahiro[/url].
